description: Looks up an entity legal form (ISO 20275 ELF code list) in a country: by ELF code first, otherwise by the legal form's local name, optionally within a region of the country.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DK.

localName.description: The legal form's local name, e.g. Anpartsselskab.

regionCode.description: ISO 3166-2 region code, for countries whose legal forms differ by region.

name: lookup_legal_form
title: Look up legal form
